name: Time Series / Observation Collection
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-DAT-010 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external research result was admitted.
Relation hold: no relation row is frozen and the WM-MAT-008 parent signal grants no approved ownership, mutation or cascade behavior.

Boundary hold: series definition, collection, observation, variable, sensor, procedure, feature, statistical unit, source dataset, processing run, release, audit and records must remain separate identities.
Temporal hold: phenomenon, reference, validity, result, availability, release, revision, recorded, ingestion, transaction and knowledge times must never be silently collapsed.
Meaning hold: observed, estimated, imputed, adjusted, nowcast, forecast and scenario values require explicit classification, source, method and uncertainty.
Authority hold: ingestion, imputation, recalculation, revision, suppression, publication, certification, unit change, access widening and records disposition require delegated authority.
Restricted-source hold: ISO 8601-1:2019 is used only from public scope and lifecycle metadata; access-restricted clauses were not inspected or inferred.
Profile hold: SSN ObservationCollection is non-normative in the cited edition, and SDMX, OMS, SSN, RDF Data Cube, CF and FHIR mappings require version pins, conformance tests and loss declarations.
Privacy hold: confidential, personal, embargoed, security-sensitive, fine-grained and reconstruction-capable observations require purpose-bound access and minimization.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
